items.label: Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 Technology
items.value: Wireless earbuds are equipped with the new Bluetooth 5.3, which fully optimizes Bluetooth transmission and connection defects, and successfully achieved non-disruptive latency. Use wireless headphones you will getting 3x faster transmission speed and more stable connectivity without signal loss or music dropouts. With a range of up to 10m, whether you are at home, in the office, or on the road, you don't have to worry about disconnection

items.label: High-fidelity Audio and ENC Noise Reduction
items.value: Bluetooth earbuds 13mm large size speaker driver delivers powerful bass, mellow midrange, and clear treble, reproducing your music vividly. Built-in high quality MIC, noise cancelling earbuds adopt ENC tech that effectively separates your voice from the ambient sound, and makes communication clear

items.label: Ergonomic Sports Design
items.value: The sports headphones features ear hooks made of an innovative TPE (elastic) material, the ultra-light and ergonomic design allows you to wear them for a long time without feeling uncomfortable. Try the three tip sizes to get snug in ear headphones fit and create a perfect seal for crystal clear sound. The wireless earbuds bluetooth are waterproof with an IP7 nano-coating to protect them when sweating or getting wet

items.label: 75 Hours Playtime and LED Digital Display
items.value: With fast charging Type-C interface, the in ear wireless headphones be fully charged for only need 1.5 hours. Playtime lasts for over 8 hours from a single charge and a total of 75 hours with the charging case. Features with a smart LED digital display, you can easily know the battery consumption on both wireless bluetooth headphones and the charging case so you can master the time to charge it

items.label: Smart Touch Controls and Wide Compatibility
items.value: Bluetooth headphones in ear with high sensitivity touch technology, and it can help you easily achieve multiple functions, including play/pause, answer/reject phone, volume adjustment, switch music, activate voice assistant, etc. Wireless headset are compatible with most Bluetooth music players including cellphones, tablets, etc

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: Cable, Eartip, User Manual, Wireless Charging Case*1, Wireless Earbuds*2

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Cellphones, Tablets, Laptops, Desktops, Smart Speakers, Televisions
